name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Channel Partnerships & B2B SaaS Business Development
summary: Partnerships and business development leader with 13+ years sourcing, qualifying, and closing B2B SaaS opportunities, from BDR prospecting through C-suite consultative sales and reseller channel management. Built and retained a 15-20 partner reseller channel at Birdeye (~94% retention, deals ~$10K-$45K), ranked top three of up to 15 reps at Accelo while quota doubled, and closed ~$130K+ in new agency bookings at Fetch & Funnel. Builds a tailored value case for each prospect, runs disciplined pipeline in Salesforce, and uses automation to research and prioritize target accounts at scale.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Built an automated prospect-research and outbound engine that scores a business's digital footprint and triggers personalized, segmented outreach, enrolling 180+ target businesses.
Run discovery directly with business owners to surface goals, market challenges, and fit before scoping an engagement, then expand retainer scope with complementary services.
Promoted a free audit offer through LinkedIn organic growth as a top-of-funnel motion, converting 2 of 180+ enrolled businesses into paying clients.
Architect CRM pipelines in GoHighLevel and HubSpot (segmentation, lifecycle stages, lead routing, data hygiene) and integrate them with Zapier, Make, and n8n.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Designed account-based LinkedIn campaigns targeting small, highly researched audiences of specific accounts and contacts, with A/B-tested setups.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations and QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail verticals, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Sold the partner value proposition around Birdeye's proprietary listings-syndication solution, the backbone of the channel offer, including channel sales to healthcare-focused agencies.
Equipped partners to sell and communicate product value to their own customers, advising on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance to find adoption gaps, and fed structured partner feedback to Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.
Maintained partner records, pipeline, and account status in Salesforce.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each (several above $25K), roughly $130K+ in total bookings in under six months.
Pursued a major northeastern U.S. banking prospect through to finalist stage, and led the sales team alongside individual account work.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while onboarding and launching 25+ clients per month.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), helping build a new vertical from proof of concept to a profitable business line and developing sales training for tenured AEs.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps across 27 months, sustained while quota roughly doubled.
Built relationships with agency and professional-services C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design, closing deals of $20K and larger.
Averaged ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue, consistently into accelerator tiers.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle new-business sales for an SMB loyalty and marketing-automation platform, from high-volume prospecting and qualification through close.

experience.title: Business Development Representative
bullets: Prospected and qualified new opportunities, booking a steady flow of sales-ready meetings for regional sales representatives.
